popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Argive tradition: Deiphontes, husband of Temenus' daughter Hyrnetho, is preferred over Temenus' sons and later rules Epidaurus — the Heraclid son-in-law whose household splits the Argolid succession.

popCulture.title: Deiphontes
popCulture.description: Heraclid husband of Hyrnetho; favourite of Temenus and later king associated with Epidaurus.
